subject: Re: Model variant compatibility: integration window & feature-flag pin request
messages:
From: Elena Rojas <elena.rojas@terra.ai>
To: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.com>
Cc: integrations@terra.ai
Date: 2025-07-12T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: New variant caused subtle hallucination pattern in image-captioning pipeline

Hi Lukas,

Quick note from our integration tests this morning: after switching to the new 'Aurora-mini-v2' generation variant your team onboarded, our image-captioning pipeline started producing a recurrent factual hallucination where numeric values (dates/years) are incremented by one in about ~3% of outputs. The behaviour disappears if we pin back to the previous variant.

Can we request a short compatibility hold (we'd like a feature-flag default to previous variant for my account) while we share logs? This is currently blocking our internal QA sign-off for the trial. We're attaching a short QC report and token-diff patch showing tokenizer alignment issues.

Proposed immediate ask: 48-72 hour pin while Redwood and TerraAI run joint profiling. If you need more time, we'll discuss a staged canary.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call later today.

— Elena
Elena Rojas
Head of Integrations, TerraAI
From: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rojas <elena.rojas@terra.ai>
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.com, grace.oconnor@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: 2025-07-12T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: New variant caused subtle hallucination pattern in image-captioning pipeline

Elena — thanks for the clear report and the diffs, appreciated.

Acking receipt and looping in infra (Karthik) + Product (Grace) to scope the ask. Short answers up front:
- We can apply a per-customer variant pin via routing rules for TerraAI within the next business day.
- We prefer to run a 72-hour compatibility window with telemetry + targeted prompt set runs to confirm impact before a longer hold.

Karthik — can you and your team run the tokenizer + KV-cache profiling Elena attached and confirm whether this looks like a tokenization misalignment vs. a model weight/regression? If tokenizer is the root cause, a patch may suffice without a long pin.

Grace — from a product & rollout perspective, what's your recommendation for a default customer-facing feature flag? If we enable a fallback to the prior variant for requests that match TerraAI's integration key, we can avoid a global rollback.

Elena — I'll schedule a 30 min sync for today (tentative invite included).

Best,
Lukas
Lukas Meyer
Director, Partnerships — Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.com>, Elena Rojas <elena.rojas@terra.ai>
Cc: grace.oconnor@redwood.com
Date: 2025-07-12T13:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: New variant caused subtle hallucination pattern in image-captioning pipeline

Thanks for the ping. Quick triage notes from the infra side after a first-pass:
- I ingested the token-diff.patch and ran a tokenization alignment check against both variants. There's a small but plausible shift in subword boundaries for a handful of date-adjacent tokens (e.g., "’24" vs "2024") that changes attention anchors in long-prefix contexts.
- KV cache handling looks stable; no corruption observed in the runtime logs.
- Latency profile for aurora-mini-v2 is within expected bounds, so this is unlikely to be a perf regression causing timeouts.

Recommendation: 
1) Apply the per-customer routing pin for TerraAI for 72 hours (to give product & QA space).
2) Run the targeted prompt-set (Elena's report) in batch on both variants and produce a differential-report (we'll attach system logs).
3) If tokenizer mismatch is confirmed as root cause, propose a tokenizer-normalization shim (non-invasive) rolled as an infra-side patch. If not, escalate to model team for a micro-weights rollback or variant re-tune.

I'll attach the initial profiler output and start the batch run tonight.

- Karthik
Sr. Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Elena Rojas <elena.rojas@terra.ai>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: 2025-07-13T08:32:00-07:00
Subject: Re: New variant caused subtle hallucination pattern in image-captioning pipeline

All — thanks for the fast triage. Product stance and asks:
- Approve the 72-hour customer-level pin for TerraAI now. Please set the routing rule with a TTL and an audit tag (so we can auto-expire unless product explicitly extends).
- Planned follow-ups during the window: run the differential prompt-set (Karthik), and a smaller human eval (3 annotators) on the failure class.
- If we confirm tokenizer as the root cause, we should ship the tokenizer-normalization shim as a hotfix (infra-owned) and verify results on a canary slice before global re-introduction.
- If instead it's a model generation/regression, product requests an extended integration window up to 14 days while the model team prepares a precision patch and we provision a canary rollout (1% -> 10% -> 50%).

Operational asks for infra: document the per-customer pin operation (who can flip it, who approves extension) and add a telemetry tag (terra_integration_fix) so we can correlate logs and reduce noise for SLO alerts.

Marissa — can you prepare the human evaluation doc and a short checklist for the QA team?

I'll approve the initial 72-hour pin now; Karthik/Lukas please confirm when the routing rule is applied.

— Grace
Senior Product Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Elena Rojas <elena.rojas@terra.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-07-14T16:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: New variant caused subtle hallucination pattern in image-captioning pipeline

Thanks everyone — appreciate the quick action and the audit controls. We're okay with the 72-hour pin as a first step. I've attached the QC spreadsheet and token diffs (compat_report_qc.xlsx, tokenizer-diff.patch) in case infra needs additional context.

We'll run the human eval on our side as well and share results by EOD Friday. If you apply the TTL, please include me on the routing-rule log for transparency.

Also, can we schedule a 30m post-mortem early next week to decide on the 14-day integration window if needed? Proposed times: Monday 10:30am PT or Tuesday 9:00am PT.

Elena

--
Attachments referenced: compat_report_qc.xlsx (spreadsheet, 42kb), tokenizer-diff.patch (text, 6kb)
